# Kyrippos II — Duke of Maretonia

*Kyrippos II* is a fan-used personal name for the *Duke of Maretonia*, a visiting Earth-pony noble in G4 *Friendship Is Magic*. Recognize him by his orange-brown coat, teal eyes, curled dark mane, long pointed beard, towering purple-and-gold hat, and elaborate blue-and-magenta cloak. He appears alongside the Duchess of Maretonia, also tagged *Ice Mirror* by fans.

The show identifies him by title, not personal name; the S4E25 voice credit says *Dignitary*. *Kyrippos II* is documented in [2016 fan fiction](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/344896/5/starlight-and-aurora/chapter-5-a-shocking-revelation) and used for Maretonia's ruler in the fan-created [*Equestria at War* continuity](https://equestriaatwar.wiki.gg/wiki/Duchy_of_Maretonia). The name's original coiner is unverified. *Neighbuchadnezzar* is another fandom tag, not an established television name.

He *does speak*: in *Twilight's Kingdom – Part 1* he requests a small circle for confidential talks. The credited voice is **Vincent Tong** ([G4 cast listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cast_(Generation_4))). He is also visible at the [*Equestria Games* (S4E24)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/equestria-games/umc.cmc.5ssbqlq4qltzwq2hsn5gr0r35?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j); the Gameloft *Magic Princess* game likewise uses the title *Duke of Maretonia* ([game character list](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Characters/D_-_K)).

## Important moments

1. **The ceremonial welcome — “Twilight's Kingdom – Part 1” (S4E25).** Twilight unfurls the banner to greet the Duke and Duchess, then wonders whether her princess duties amount to more than smiling and waving. [Full-episode listing on Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/twilights-kingdom---part-1/umc.cmc.rit0fxs1ei5egv4aw82vdyl3?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (verified timestamp unavailable).
2. **Keeping talks confidential — “Twilight's Kingdom – Part 1” (S4E25).** The Duke thanks Celestia for limiting who can hear the diplomatic discussion, contributing to Twilight's feeling of exclusion before “You'll Play Your Part.” [Episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s04e25&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic) (verified timestamp unavailable).
